id: title:Gilbert09:accept batches that declare a null column not null

observations.behavior: Checks each PyArrow table column; if a declared non-nullable field actually contains nulls, its metadata is updated to allow nulls.
observations.posthog_connection: This prevents warehouse ingestion failures where SQL sources declare NOT NULL columns but emit null values due to joins or projections.

observations.behavior: Calls the relaxation function before invoking Delta Lake write and merge operations on SCD2 tables.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse sync pipelines to complete despite mismatched source database metadata without raising errors or panicking in Rust.

observations.behavior: Tests that an incremental writer successfully stores rows with nulls when the batch schema was corrected from false NOT NULL claims.
observations.posthog_connection: Demonstrates end-to-end recovery of warehouse writes for common CDC scenarios where upstream databases report incorrect nullable metadata.

observations.limitations: Only backend warehouse ingestion paths are shown. No shared library compatibility checks, no production configuration changes, and no rollback strategy are visible.
